description: We’re building KEMET, an AI-assisted Earth-system intelligence platform focused on Egypt. It connects NASA Earth data on climate, water, agriculture, food security, and ecosystems to reveal trends, relationships, and potential solutions. We’re looking for developers, AI/data scientists, GIS experts, environmental researchers, and designers. Interested? Join us and build KEMET!
summary: Kemet is an interactive environmental intelligence platform focused on Egypt. It combines NASA Earth observation data, climate analysis, and an experimental agricultural sandbox to help users explore environmental conditions and understand how different decisions may affect natural resources. The platform aims to make environmental information more accessible to researchers, farmers, students, and decision-makers.
details:
Kemet — Environmental Intelligence and Agricultural Simulation

Kemet is an interactive platform designed to make environmental data easier to understand and explore, with a focus on Egypt and with intention to increase our scale to the whole world.

The Problem

Environmental and agricultural decisions require information about climate, precipitation, water availability, and changing environmental conditions. However, interpreting these datasets can be challenging for non-specialists .

Our Solution

Kemet brings environmental intelligence and interactive exploration together in a unified platform.

Its Earth Intelligence component uses NASA climate data to visualize temperature, precipitation, and modeled root-zone wetness across selected locations and time periods.

Users can explore historical environmental patterns, compare conditions across months, and examine climate anomalies through interactive charts and summaries.

Kemet also includes an experimental agricultural sandbox intended to help users explore how choices involving crops, irrigation, and resources may affect simulated outcomes.

Technology

The platform is developed using web technologies, including Next.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript, with interactive data visualizations and NASA Earth science datasets.

Impact

Kemet aims to support environmental education, encourage data-informed thinking, and make scientific information more accessible to farmers, researchers, students, and decision-makers.

Limitations

Climate data and simulation outputs are intended for exploratory and educational purposes. Modeled environmental estimates should not be interpreted as direct farm-level measurements or validated agricultural predictions.
